maria: Quick thread — replay vs synthetic showed a p99 jump on rtx-a100-80gb when moving driver 525.60 -> 525.85. Suspect kernel selection fallback + KV miss amplification. Repro harness + short profile below.

jin: Which exact driver + CUDA + container image?

maria: Driver=525.85, CUDA=11.8, image=rdinfer/runtime:2025-03-08-gpu. Run: `./replay_runner --trace prod_trace_2025-03-08.json --driver 525.85`

ravi: Did you match the seqlen distribution and inter-arrival microbursts? Synthetic usually hides KV thrash.

maria: Seqlen histogram = prod trace. Synthetic used steady poisson with low variance; replay has spikes. Profile snippet shows kernel_select shifted at microbursts -> fallback to generic path.

maria: ```
# trace excerpt t=00:02:13
kernel_select: aten_matmul_v2 -> generic_matmul
batch_window_ms: 6 -> 1.2
KV_miss_rate: 0.12 -> 0.41
SM_occupancy: 0.68
L2_miss_percent: 17.9
```

sam: If kernel selection flips when batch<4 we saw regressions before. Try runtime flags: kernel_policy=prefer_fast, kv_prefetch=enabled.

maria: Tried kv_prefetch=on: mean 42.3ms -> 43.2ms (+2%), but p99 210ms -> 197ms (-6%). So it reduces tail at cost of a slight mean bump.

jin: Can you attach the perf counters and a small flamegraph? Also include the exact kernel selector log lines.

maria: Uploaded short artifacts to /runs/2227771111/artifacts (profile, flamegraph, kernel_selector.log). Minimal flamegraph: hotspot at aten_matmul_v2_fast when batch>=8, otherwise generic path dominates.

perf-bot: perfregression: created issue PR-487 for driver 525.85 p99 delta (labels: perf, blocking).

ravi: Hypothesis: quantized/fast kernel requires stable batch window; microbursting causes selector to fall back. For apples-to-apples, run synthetic replay with same bursty inter-arrival envelope (poisson bursts, 90th percentile bursts=8 reqs/10ms).

maria: Good plan. I'll run a heatmap sweep across driver variants (525.60, 525.80, 525.85) x kernel_policy x kv_prefetch and record mean/p99 + KV hit curves. Pinning to 525.60 looks stable in quick checks. Artifacts will be in the run dir and I will ping when uploads complete.

jin: :thumbsup: Ping me when the run finishes, I'll instrument kernel_selector to emit decision reasons to s3 so we can correlate exact fallback times.

maria: Will do. Next step: run replay with microburst overlay + synthetic with burst envelope, then compare heatmap. If consistent, open a follow-up for runtime change or selector smoothing.
